subject: [hw] IV -> V34: foreign-share carry patch applied; V34 2035/2035 + V34CORE 103/103
body: Applied to shim/n2shim_android.c as posted: a `foreign` byte on struct n2and_ion_buf, set by n2shim_ion_register_share(), and sh_ion_free()/sh_ion_share_close() are no-ops for foreign entries (the exporter keeps the buffer and the share id valid across jobs). Your suite still passes: N2TEST V34 PASS 2035/2035 (asan/o2/tsan) and N2TEST V34CORE PASS 103/103. Effect on the real vendor set: the second encode's ion_import(0x501) succeeds and the daemon reaches the VENC; before the patch it logged 'ion_import failed, ion_buf_fd = 1281'. Revert freely if you prefer a different ownership model.
